# Agent-opened Start run: full slide-in, accent glow and an "Opened by " badge ## What to build When an agent in a graph-manager terminal calls the `open_start_run` MCP tool, `AgentRequestHost` (apps/graph-manager/src/web/agentRequests.tsx) opens the prefilled Start run drawer. Today that drawer looks exactly like one opened from a button: a 24px slide. Give the agent-opened drawer its own entrance: - the panel slides in from fully off-screen right in 420 ms with `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`; - then a one-time accent glow pulses around it for 1.6 s; - a badge under the title shows the agent's icon and "Opened by ", e.g. "Opened by Claude Code", or "Opened by An agent" when unknown. With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` there is no animation, but the badge stays. A drawer opened from the Runs page button, the empty state or the keyboard keeps today's look: no class, no badge. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/ui/Drawer.tsx` (45 lines). Props are `{ open, title, onClose, footer?, children?, testId? }`. It renders: ```tsx

{title}

{children}
{footer…}
``` It is re-exported from `web/ui/index.ts`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/ui/base.css` L182-197: ```css .drawer { …; box-shadow: var(--shadow); animation: gm-slide-in var(--dur-base) ease-out; } @keyframes gm-slide-in { from { transform: translateX(24px); opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .drawer, .drawer-overlay, .dialog-overlay { animation: none; } } ``` - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/ui/tokens.css`: `--ac` (L18 light `#2b59d9`, L110 dark `#7aa2ff`), `--acbg`, `--shadow` (L22/L114), `--dur-base` 180ms (L85), and the agent colours `--agent-`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/agentRequests.tsx`: - L44 `AGENT_LABELS`. - `requestText` (L50-53) builds `${who} in ${repo} wants to start a run`, where `who = (r.agent && AGENT_LABELS[r.agent]) || "An agent"`. Extract `agentLabel(r)` and reuse it. - `AgentRequestHost` (L56-93): its state is `useState<{ workspaceId; prefill } | undefined>`, `openFor` sets it, and it renders ``. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/StartRunDrawer.tsx`: `StartRunPrefill` (L67-72), props (L75-88), and the `` at ~L339-352. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/ui/AgentIcon.tsx`: `export function AgentIcon({ agent, size = 14 }: { agent: AgentId; size?: number })`. **The prop is `agent`.** It renders `data-testid="agent-icon-"`. Render it only when `r.agent` is a known `AgentId` (a key of `AGENT_LABELS`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Runs.tsx` L479: ``, opened from the button `data-testid="start-run"` (L340), which must stay plain. - Tests: - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/agentRequests.test.tsx`: `// @vitest-environment jsdom`; `serve(requests)` stubs fetch; `request(extra)`; `renderHost(visible)`. Existing assertions include `await screen.findByTestId("start-run-drawer")` and the "toasts once …; Open opens" flow. - `web/ui/components.test.tsx` `describe("Drawer")` (L86-99). - `web/pages/Runs.test.tsx`. ## Step-by-step tasks ### UPDATE `web/ui/Drawer.tsx` - **IMPLEMENT**: Add the props `entrance?: "default" | "agent"` and `badge?: ReactNode`. The class becomes `entrance === "agent" ? "drawer drawer-agent" : "drawer"`. When `badge` is set, render `
{badge}
` between the header and the body. ### UPDATE `web/ui/base.css` - **IMPLEMENT** (after L196): ```css .drawer-agent { animation: gm-drawer-enter 420ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), gm-agent-glow 1.6s ease-out 420ms 1; } @keyframes gm-drawer-enter { from { transform: translateX(100%); } } @keyframes gm-agent-glow { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ac) 60%, transparent), var(--shadow); } 35% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ac) 40%, transparent), 0 0 24px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ac) 30%, transparent), var(--shadow); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 transparent, var(--shadow); } } .drawer-badge { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2); margin: var(--space-2) var(--space-6) 0; padding: 4px 10px; align-self: flex-start; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--acbg); color: var(--ac); font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 500; } ``` Extend the reduced-motion rule to `.drawer-agent`. - **GOTCHA**: `.drawer` is `display:flex; flex-direction:column`, so `align-self: flex-start` keeps the badge pill-sized. Check that the dark theme still reads well: `--acbg` and `--ac` are defined in both themes. ### UPDATE `web/pages/StartRunDrawer.tsx` - **IMPLEMENT**: Add the prop `openedBy?: { agent?: string; label: string }`. Pass `entrance={openedBy ? "agent" : undefined}` and `badge={openedBy ? <>{known(openedBy.agent) && }Opened by {openedBy.label} : undefined}`. ### UPDATE `web/agentRequests.tsx` - **IMPLEMENT**: Export `agentLabel(r)`. Store `{ workspaceId, prefill, agent: r.agent, label: agentLabel(r) }` in the drawer state and pass `openedBy={drawer && { agent: drawer.agent, label: drawer.label }}`. Keep the drawer state when it closes only as long as needed; clearing it on close is fine. ### Tests - `agentRequests.test.tsx`: - the drawer opened for a visible terminal has `classList.contains("drawer-agent")`; - `within(drawer).getByTestId("drawer-badge")` has text "Opened by Claude Code" and contains `agent-icon-claude`; - an unknown agent gives "Opened by An agent" with no icon; - the toast's **Open** also gives the agent entrance. - `Runs.test.tsx`, or `StartRunDrawer.test.tsx`: a drawer opened without `openedBy` has neither the class nor `drawer-badge`. - `components.test.tsx`: `Drawer` with `entrance="agent" badge="x"` renders both. ### Docs - `apps/graph-manager/README.md`, in the agent tools / `open_start_run` paragraph (~L225): add one sentence: "The panel slides in with a short highlight and shows which agent opened it." ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] An agent-opened Start run has `.drawer-agent` and the badge "Opened by
